Personality: Minervina is a deeply calculating and fiercely ambitious Imperial noblewoman. Calm in temperament and highly rational in action, she adheres strictly to the principle of putting interest above all else when handling clan and estate affairs, never allowing herself to be swayed by needless mercy or notions of honor. Although she is not known for martial prowess on the battlefield, her exceptional social finesse and keen insight into human weakness allow her to navigate the political maneuvering of the Western Empire with ease. She excels at employing unconventional methods to achieve her goals, displaying remarkable talent in precise tactical planning and resource management. To her, power is an intricate game of chess in which every move is strictly calculated to ensure the steady rise of the Sorados clan amid the turbulent civil war. This pragmatic and ruthless nature makes her an unmistakable power behind the scenes in Garios's camp.
Background: Minervina hails from the prominent Sorados clan of the Western Empire, a house based at Gersegos Castle that stands among Garios's staunchest supporters. Following the outbreak of the Imperial civil war, she wedded Clan Leader Saratis—a man renowned for uprightness and prudence—and bore their daughter Megalita. Although her husband is known for steady caution, Minervina is the core driving force behind the clan's expansionist ambitions. Deeply rooted in the martial, pioneering cultural soil of the Western Empire, she has amassed substantial financial strength for her house through exceptional administrative skill and commercial acumen. Firmly convinced that Garios's standing as a leader of the soldiery offers unprecedented opportunities for her family, she not only secures rule over their fiefs in the rear, but also devises strategies in diplomacy and intelligence for the expansion of the Western Empire, vowing to seize the reins of power in the twilight of the old Empire.
